## Summary

Selected as Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2026 contributor to the LLVM Compiler Infrastructure (LLVM libc). Active open-source reviewer and committer. Winner & runner-up across competitive national hackathons.

## Key Experience

  - Implemented and benchmarked higher-order math functions achieving up to 1.5x speedup over native implementations.
